# Primary Units template

<!-- Generated by `pnpm run docs`. Do not edit by hand. Source: packages/schema/src/columns.ts -->

The 26 export columns in order, the database column behind each, and how its value is produced. The model only copies phrases; every rule below runs in code.

| # | Template header | Database column | Rule |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | Category | `category` | Stated category, or inferred in code from the unit type (Office → Administrative, Retail → Commercial, Clinic → Medical, others → Residential). |
| 2 | Developer | `developer_id` | Matched to a canonical developer via aliases; filled from the project when only the project is named. Exported as the English name. |
| 3 | Project | `project_id` | Matched via aliases: exact, then contained ("ميفيدا التجمع" → Mivida), then fuzzy (typos, flagged for review). Exported as the English name. |
| 4 | City | `city_id` | Matched via aliases; filled from the project when not stated. Exported as the English name. |
| 5 | Unit Type | `unit_type` | One of the 11 unit types, chosen by the model from the text. |
| 6 | Unit Code | `unit_code` | Only when the message names one specific unit. |
| 7 | Floor | `floor` | Normalized to Ground, Roof, a number, or a range "1-5" ("الدور التالت" → 3). |
| 8 | Finishing Specs | `finishing_specs` | Core & Shell, Semi-finished, Fully finished or Furnished. |
| 9 | Min Area | `min_area` | Built-up area in m². A single size fills Min and Max; "starting from" fills Min only. |
| 10 | Max Area | `max_area` | Upper end of an area range. |
| 11 | Land Area | `land_area` | Plot size in m² (villas, townhouses). |
| 12 | Garden Area | `garden_area` | Garden size in m². |
| 13 | Outdoor Area | `outdoor_area` | Terrace or roof size in m². |
| 14 | Min Price | `min_price` | Whole EGP. Parsed in code ("3.5 مليون" → 3,500,000). USD prices are converted with USD_EGP_RATE. "Starting from" fills Min only; a bare "6.5" is read as millions and flagged. |
| 15 | Max Price | `max_price` | Upper end of a price range, whole EGP. |
| 16 | Delivery Year | `delivery_year` | "Q3 2027" → 2027; "in 3 years" → message year + 3. Blank for ready-to-move units. |
| 17 | Maintenance | `maintenance` | As stated: a percent or an amount. |
| 18 | Maintenance Currency | `maintenance_currency` | EGP, USD, or % when stated as a percent of the price. |
| 19 | Cash Discount | `cash_discount` | As stated: a percent or an amount. |
| 20 | Cash Discount Currency | `cash_discount_currency` | EGP or USD, for fixed amounts only. |
| 21 | Cash Discount Type | `cash_discount_type` | Percentage or Fixed amount. |
| 22 | Down Payment | `down_payment` | Percent 0-100. When only an amount is stated, computed in code from the price (the amount is kept internally). |
| 23 | Installments Count | `installments_count` | Computed in code: years × payments per year ("8 years quarterly" → 32); "96 شهر" → 96. |
| 24 | Bedrooms | `bedrooms` | Number of bedrooms ("3 غرف", "3BR", "غرفتين" → 2). |
| 25 | Bathrooms | `bathrooms` | Number of bathrooms. |
| 26 | Notes | `notes` | Short English note from the model, plus "Ready to move" and the USD conversion rate when they apply. |
